Definition: to lack; by implication, to fail, want, lessen
BiblicalUsage: 1) to lack, be without, decrease, be lacking, have a need; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to lack; 1a2) to be lacking; 1a3) to diminish, decrease; 1b) (Piel) to cause to lack; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to be lacking
